mappings.target_semantic: Resident context for intent problem and task planning
mappings.transformation: Preserve stated occupancy count and pattern without inferring household roles, diagnosis, culture or needs.
mappings.loss_policy: Retain source values and source IDs; unresolved target fields remain explicit.

mappings.target_semantic: Functional task set and intent objectives
mappings.transformation: Preserve activity ID, wording, frequency, dedicated-space and privacy intent; any decomposition references the source activity ID.
mappings.loss_policy: No activity may be dropped or silently generalized.

mappings.target_semantic: Spatial relationship constraints and facet-specific topology questions
mappings.transformation: Preserve each source relation and both activity endpoints; ambiguous target relations stay unresolved.
mappings.loss_policy: Do not infer exact geometry or merge distinct visibility/acoustic/access relations.

mappings.target_semantic: Hard constraints and room/task review requirements
mappings.transformation: Preserve severity NON_NEGOTIABLE, constraint ID, owner and evidence reference.
mappings.loss_policy: Never convert a hard requirement into a weight, reward, preference or soft penalty.

mappings.target_semantic: Preference vector, tradeability and decision provenance
mappings.transformation: Preserve preference ID, priority, tradeability and exact source statement.
mappings.loss_policy: No preference is replaced or scalarized into an opaque universal home score.

mappings.source_semantic: Site, rights, climate and authority references
mappings.target_semantic: Versioned site/context input and applicability questions
mappings.transformation: Preserve artifact reference, jurisdiction and evidence state.
mappings.loss_policy: Unknown rights, survey, soil or authority facts remain unknown; no parcel inference.

mappings.transformation: Pass only declarative requirements and source revision; adapted design becomes a new lineage.
mappings.loss_policy: A blueprint or work package does not authorize fabrication or occupied-home execution.

mappings.target_semantic: Consent, provenance, revocation and sharing decision
mappings.transformation: Bind source purpose, data-sharing mode, redaction status and consent evidence.
mappings.loss_policy: No external export on denied, revoked or ambiguous consent.

questions: local product availability and dated quotations

claim_ceiling: Proposed semantic crosswalk only. No target owner schema path is confirmed, no runtime adapter is connected, no geometry or accessibility result is produced.
